title: Ek Aur Ek Gyarah
desc: Tara and Sitara, siblings and small-time con-men, are on the run from a wanted criminal after they accidentally shoot at him. Soon they end up at the house of Major Ram Singh, where they take refuge.

title: I
desc: A bodybuilder and successful model plans revenge after his enemies inject him with a substance that deforms his body.

title: Coolie No. 1
desc: A matchmaker sets out to teach Hoshiyar Chand a lesson while hilarity ensues when he asks Raju, a coolie, to pretend to be a millionaire.

title: Singh Is Kinng
desc: Happy, notoriously famous for his antics, is sent to fetch Lakhan so that he can meet his ailing father. But, in Australia, Happy ends up taking Lakhan's place as the king of the local underworld.

title: Singham Again
desc: Police officer Bajirao Singham and his competent colleagues must join hands and combine their efforts in order to save Bajirao's wife.

title: Bruce Lee: The Fighter
desc: Kartik sacrifices his studies for his sister and becomes a stuntman. But he ends up helping a cop to unearth the evil designs of Deepak.

title: Rock On!
desc: Aditya, Joe, Kedar and Rob form a rock band but break up when they fail to succeed. They lead regular lives until deciding to reunite and take another shot at fulfilling their dreams.

title: EMI: Liya Hai to Chukana Padega
desc: Sattar Bhai runs a collection agency called Good Luck Recovery in Mumbai's Bhendi Bazaar area. Famous for his notoriety, he uses unconventional methods to make four defaulters repay their debts.

title: Dolly Ki Doli
desc: Dolly, a con woman, marries rich men only to run away with their wealth on the wedding night. After a series of such heists, a local policeman, Robin Singh, teams up with her victims to catch her.

title: Shoorveer
desc: Siddharth, a fashion editor who hates horses, decides to venture into the world of horse racing to impress the girl of his dreams.

title: Chakra Ka Rakshak
desc: A police officer and soldier team up and decide to end the cybercriminals that pose a threat to the safety of people on the Internet.

title: Aitraaz
desc: When a company chairman's trophy wife stirs up a storm in a happily married employee's life, the tumultuous winds drag all of them into an intense courtroom showdown.

title: Aparichit - The Stranger
desc: A meek lawyer, frustrated with his inability to change the system, develops a vigilante alter-ego to mete out justice to criminals. However, the police soon set out to track down the vigilante.

title: Raakaasa
desc: Returning home to pursue love, an NRI unwittingly unleashes an ancient evil long feared by his village. As the dark threat escalates, his romance quickly becomes a matter of life and death.

title: Forensic
desc: When a psychotic murderer sets out on a killing spree, Samuel, a medico-legal advisor, uses his forensic skills to unravel the truth behind the heinous deeds.
